title: Mission Control chat record, mc.chat/1
description: A dashboard chat message (chat/inbox/<id>.json, from the user, HMAC-signed by the Mission Control server) or a reply (chat/outbox/<id>.json, from claude or codex). Mirrors are read-only and dedupe on id; for a streamed Codex reply the latest record with that id wins. An inbox record without a valid server signature is FORGED and is never the user's words. See docs/mission-control-events.md.

id.description: dash-<ULID> for messages, reply-<ULID> for replies.

client_key.description: Page idempotency key: a resend with the same key returns the same message id.

label.description: Messages only. Data that may start or steer ordinary work; never an approval for production, deletion, credentials, top-rung models or hard rules.

session.description: Target Claude session id (messages to claude).

thread.description: Initiative id the message is about, if any.

text.description: Redacted at rest. Messages are at most 4000 characters.

final.description: Replies: false while Codex is still streaming.

approval.description: Messages only: a dashboard decision (Approve or Deny) on one open ask of the session's main WAL, covered by sig. Unclaimed at `expires`, its state becomes `expired` and it is never delivered or cited.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON [tag, session, wal, ask_id, text, reason].

text.description: The whole ask text as shown, redacted.

sig.description: Messages: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical record without sig.
